data.one_liner: Prebuilt live audio room kit with UI and chat functionality for group voice calls.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ready-made group voice chat component supporting up to 8 hosts and co-hosts. Includes built-in business logic, seat management, real-time interactive text chat, and UI styling.
use_when: You want to rapidly build or prototype a live audio room or voice chat application.
You need complete UI and business logic for speaker seats and audience interactions out-of-the-box.
avoid_when: You need a low-level audio streaming engine without prebuilt UI widgets.
Your target Android platform cannot support compileSdk 37 or higher.
strengths: Includes fully-featured UI alongside backend live audio management logic.
Supports customizable seat layouts, menu bars, and virtual gifts.
Provides quick integration paths with minimal setup time.
weaknesses: Tied to a heavy specific ecosystem kit with multiple dependencies.
Requires high compileSdk configurations on Android.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting Android compileSdk to 37 or higher due to the permission_handler dependency requirement.
data.minimal_example:
ZegoUIKitPrebuiltLiveAudioRoom(
  appID: yourAppID,
  appSign: yourAppSign,
  userID: yourUserID,
  userName: yourUserName,
  roomID: yourRoomID,
  config: ZegoUIKitPrebuiltLiveAudioRoomConfig.audience(),
)
